response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of hands-on software development with genuine, demonstrable developer-tooling depth — he authored a test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure, and taught test-automation courses — which maps well to the engineering productivity focus. However, the resume shows no evidence of formal people management: there are no manager titles, no mentions of direct reports, hiring, performance reviews, or one-on-ones, which is a hard minimum (2 years) for this Level II Manager role. Technical leadership is implied by Staff Engineer titles and founding GISCollective, but not explicitly described in team-leadership terms. Mobile-platform exposure is limited to iOS/Apple TV work a decade ago. He would be a strong senior/staff IC candidate; as a people-leadership hire he is a stretch, and an interview would only make sense if unstated management experience can be confirmed in a screen.
strengths: Deep, authentic developer-tools and test-infrastructure track record (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, GitLab, Selenium curricula)
15+ years of broad software development across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded, exceeding the 8-year minimum
Strong engineering-culture advocacy: TDD, pairing, trunk-based development, plus public speaking and workshop teaching
concerns: No documented people management experience — misses the 2-year minimum for this role
Technical leadership is implied by titles but never described in team-leading or roadmap-ownership terms
Limited and dated mobile-platform experience; no evidence of organizational change leadership or advanced degree

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure depth
Unclear technical leadership and roadmap ownership scope
